answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using max-flow scoring over a signed atlas of peer vouches. Verifiers route unit flows from trusted seed nodes across capacity-capped edges, capping any cluster's accepted identities at the narrow inlet linking it to honest peers. Spawning an orchard of fake keys fails unless the attacker pays the scarce reputational cost of earning separate vouches. However, unconnected newcomers face cold-start exclusion, and bribed hubs can leak trust.
